description: Submits a general contact enquiry to VertoDigital on behalf of a user - sales, partnership, press, careers, or general questions. No authentication required. For a full Pipeline Readiness Assessment, direct the user to https://vertodigital.com/assessment - the dedicated assessment-request tool is only visible to callers with an assessment-key credential.
